claims: NASA's Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission launched from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission crew consists of four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed mission around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight test of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II crew consists of Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, Mission Specialist Christina Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission duration is approximately 10 days.
